data.one_liner: Log, inspect, and share REST and GraphQL requests by shaking your phone.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package for logging REST APIs and GraphQL requests. It provides an inspector widget that can be opened by shaking the phone or long-pressing the screen, letting developers view request details, copy cURL commands, and export HAR files.
use_when: You need an on-device UI to debug and inspect network traffic during development.
You want to easily share request details, cURL commands, or HAR files with team members.
avoid_when: You are running a production app where network payload logging and request interception tools should be disabled.
strengths: Supports both REST (via Dio or manual controller entry) and GraphQL.
Can trigger the inspector view by shaking the phone or long-pressing the screen.
Allows sharing requests as JSON, cURL, or HAR files.
weaknesses: Relies on specific interceptors or manual logging if not using Dio or graphql_flutter.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your MaterialApp or root widget with RequestsInspector and add the RequestsInspectorInterceptor to Dio.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Dio is an alternative powerful HTTP client that features its own interceptor system and ecosystem plugins.
